WITH qc_with_projects AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') as fundflux
  FROM scanqc q
  INNER JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as qc_count
  FROM qc_with_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
stats AS (
  SELECT SUM(qc_count)::numeric as total_qc, COUNT(*) as num_funding_sources
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.fundflux,
  g.qc_count,
  g.qc_count::numeric / s.total_qc as fraction_of_total,
  g.qc_count::numeric / (s.total_qc / s.num_funding_sources) as count_divided_by_avg
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY g.fundflux

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in fundflux are treated as a separate group labeled 'Missing', included in both the grouping and the count of distinct funding sources
Average count per funding source = total QC records ÷ number of distinct funding source groups (including the 'Missing' group)
